text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The final crown of the Tiara route, the 
Shuka Sho, had finally arrived—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Kyoto Racecourse was enveloped in an 
extraordinary fervor.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ooooohhh...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The first Triple Tiara in history! I'll 
bear witness to history being made with my 
own two eyes...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Lady Mejiro Ramonu! Lady Mejiro Ramonu! 
Lady Mejiro Ramonu...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, high expectations! It reminds me of 
your Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It had a similar atmosphere back during 
your time too.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Back in my time, there were probably a 
few more people who looked uneasy."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Besides... this whole 'taken for granted' 
vibe. Yeah, it's definitely just like back 
when it was you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Had it been any girl other than 
Ramonu, I would have felt guilty for 
making her grow accustomed to such an 
atmosphere."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well, I suppose so. Normally, someone 
might feel a lot of pressure from that.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Want me to guess? What kind of face 
Ramonu is making right now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: This is hardly a contest. Now then...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh, aren't you going to watch it here?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm scheduled to witness this historic 
moment alongside key race officials.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
After that, we plan to hold a panel 
discussion on the future of the Umamusume 
world based on today's events.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I would love to invite Ramonu as well, 
but... if I disturb her lingering mood, 
she'll glare right through me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, Ramonu probably doesn't care 
about the future in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Young Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"—The full moon is beautiful. Without a 
single flaw... a truly perfect form."

text_block_list.name: Young Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"It's only natural to give your everything 
for what you want."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
――...When it comes to racing, I know 
she'll stand beside me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's time. Let's both go out there and 
enjoy the race.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...I see. So you're the one who doubts it 
the least.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Ramonu. Right now, no one is more bound 
by expectations than you."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I'm sure... you'll still be free 
today, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Will she achieve the first Triple Tiara in 
history— Amid the whirlwind of 
anticipation filling the racecourse, 
Mejiro Ramonu... quietly made her 
preparations.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as always, she meticulously checks 
her body... Confirming if she can run at 
full strength—and if she can love the race 
with everything she is.
choice_data_list:
(It'd probably be tactless to say 
something now.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"...Today, the shape of this love will 
become visible."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I wonder... what color it is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was a somewhat dreamy tone to the 
way she spoke. Perhaps the one looking 
forward to today the most... was she 
herself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Now then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Pardon?
choice_data_list:
I'm looking forward to the start of a new 
history!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Are you sure you're fine with that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Believe in yourself and run it through to 
the end... Is that not it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Could you please dust it off for me? After 
all... it has been waiting for so long.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"The brilliance that awaits me— I'm coming 
for it now."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Kyoto Racecourse was enveloped in immense 
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"The final crown! It surely belongs upon 
Mejiro Ramonu-sama's head...!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
The face of this year's Tiara circuit is 
Lady Mejiro Ramonu!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Man, Ramonu is as popular as ever, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
An atmosphere where not a single soul 
doubts her victory... Well, after seeing a 
run like that, it's only natural.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"She may not have achieved the Triple 
Tiara, but her running is as flawless as 
ever."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
An ordinary girl would probably feel the 
pressure, but...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Want me to guess? What kind of face 
Ramonu is making right now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: This is hardly a contest. Now then...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh, aren't you going to watch it here?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm scheduled to watch today's race 
alongside key race officials.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
After that, we plan to hold a panel 
discussion on the future of the Umamusume 
world based on today's events.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I would love to invite Ramonu as well, 
but... if I disturb her lingering mood, 
she'll glare right through me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, Ramonu probably doesn't care 
about the future in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Young Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"—The full moon is beautiful. Without a 
single flaw... a truly perfect form."

text_block_list.name: Young Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"It's only natural to give your everything 
for what you want."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
――...When it comes to racing, I know 
she'll stand beside me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's time. Let's both go out there and 
enjoy the race.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Whether you call it trust or something 
else.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Ramonu. Right now, no one is more bound 
by expectations than you."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I'm sure... you'll still be free 
today, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu will surely win— Amidst an 
atmosphere swirling with immense 
expectations, she herself... quietly and 
solemnly went about her preparations.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as always, she meticulously checks 
her body... Confirming if she can run at 
full strength—and if she can love the race 
with everything she is.
choice_data_list:
(It'd probably be tactless to say 
something now.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Today marks a turning point.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
A single form is nearing completion... I 
wonder what color it will take on.
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to finding out.
I'm looking forward to finding out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Is it truly fine for you not to tell her 
to believe in herself and run it through?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Come—let us go to claim today's victory.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text: ――I understand.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
I'm not that person. I can never be that 
person.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text: She... will never look back.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text: "Even so... I am... I...—"
